children: Duos entered into employment agreements appointing F. Douglas Recker as Chief Executive Officer (effective April 1, 2026) and Dipan Patel as Chief Operating Officer (effective June 15, 2026), each on three-year terms with specified salary, bonus and equity arrangements.

Base salary $650,000; target bonus 125% of salary; equity grants including 400,000 restricted shares (vesting Jan 1, 2028) and up to 880,000 additional restricted shares across 2027–2028 with time- and performance-based vesting; three-year term to Mar 31, 2029; change-of-control acceleration.
Base salary $375,000; target bonus 80% of salary; grant of 200,000 restricted shares with three-year cliff vesting on June 30, 2029; three-year term to June 14, 2029; change-of-control acceleration.
